OK, perhaps I should have said 'folder'.  I am also assuming Windows as the OS here.

If that is still confusing, then follow the following steps to get there:

  1. Open File Explorer
  2. Click This PC in the sidebar and then double-click the drive with (C:) at the end of it
  3. Find and double-click the Users folder
  4. Find and double-click the folder for your Windows username (probably your full name)
  5. Continue to double-click on the following folders in the rest of the path in order: AppData, LocalLow, Handelabra Games Inc_, Sentinels
  6. Look for log.txt in this folder/directory.
